acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec amendment (requirement IDs, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence, rollback) defines the application-marker declaration and the four classifications in the owning test-validity contract; lane requirements are accepted under the owner's standing auto-accept of 2026-10-11.
A control run whose target step passes and which carries no application marker is reported NOT-APPLIED, never as a pass or fail of the control, and the strength axis abstains for that control.
The report lists inert controls separately, and repeated NOT-APPLIED for the same control across revisions is flagged as a control defect.
Focused and hostile tests plus a real Playwright control run (or a bounded NOT_RUN reason) and sealed change evidence; GitHub #872 closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#872 (2026-10-14). A hand-authored negative control (e.g. a page.route handler that drops one item from a POST body, guarded by shape checks that fall back via route.fallback() and record an annotation when it fires) can be inert: when the real request has a different shape the guard always falls back, the perturbation never happens, the row assertion passes and the control run is green, which reads as 'control did not break the test' (a false strength claim or confusing non-result). The reporter caught one inert control across two revisions only with their own checker comparing 'row step passed' against 'applied annotation present'. Proposal: make 'the control took effect' a first-class axis: a control declares an application marker (annotation type or provider event); each control run is classified APPLIED-FAILED (valid control), APPLIED-EARLY-FAIL (an earlier step failed first), APPLIED-PASSED (assertion too weak) or NOT-APPLIED (inert), and NOT-APPLIED is never credited as strength or weakness; repeated NOT-APPLIED for the same control across revisions is flagged as a control defect; optionally record the observed request shape (keys only, no values) when a guarded handler falls back.
title: test-validity: report inert negative controls as NOT-APPLIED instead of crediting a passing control run (GitHub #872)
